title: Edison takeover
body:
The DataFrame $$	ext{ed\_replies}$$ is created for an Ed reply predictor.
The columns of $$	ext{ed\_replies}$$ are described below:
• ed id: The Ed reply's unique id (type $$=$$ np.int64).
• length: The number of characters in the reply (type $$=$$ np.int64).
• likes: The number of likes the reply received (type $$=$$ np.int64).
• response time: The number of minutes between the time of the reply and the time of its original post (type $$=$$ np.int64).
• bot: Indicates if the reply was made by an Ed bot. $$0$$ for a human and $$1$$ for an Ed bot (type $$=$$ np.int64).
